vehicle.loss: mean nonempty identities separately for interior and edge; each category weight 1
vehicle.other_vehicles: union all vehicle/native proposal masks minus selected five labels
vehicle.target: current frozen V1 composite RGB; never hidden road RGB truth

policy.outside_reliable: full composite matches frozen current V1; no road GT RGB; vehicle categories normalized separately

input_roles.RGB: same-frame native camera original_image at training; overlay is display only
input_roles.LiDAR: measured small triangles + fixed-surface agreement; interpolated depth explicitly derived
input_roles.masks: five selected + all vehicles + native proposals, dilated; all annotated 3D boxes checked
input_roles.cross_view: at least two current-frame measured patches agree; no color-based rejection
input_roles.road: geometric ground candidate, not dense semantic ground truth
input_roles.protection: all pixels outside reliable road use frozen native full-scene RGB, never independent road GT

SSIM: Gaussian-weighted valid-pixel moments; >=80% valid pixels, no hidden values in moments
overlay_legend: R3 evidence classification retained: yellow unknown pixels now use frozen native composite reference only
